record.body: Current marketplace default d92e65b761788c8ec18562d3d1183bce29c341f7 contains R67 independence weighting, R68 run-closure observability and R69 request->workflow->receipt causality. Preserved options: correlated consumers remain lawful but discounted, PR #291 remains provenance only, and existing R61/R63/R65 paths remain active. 1000X remains NOT_ADMITTED; weakest multiplier is causally grounded independent consumer breadth plus observed downstream manufacturing yield.
